query: pump bearing wear vibration PM interval operating experience OE not incorporated systemic latent

results.snippet: Bearing failure confirmed. Vibration exceeded 6.5 mils starting 4 hours before trip. Lubrication PM was overdue 47 days. Bearing type BRNG-4518.

Lubrication PM interval of 90 days appears inadequate for bearing type BRNG-4518. Fleet OE document OE-2024-114 identified faster wear rates on this bearing design and recommended 60-day PM interval, but engineering evaluation to update PM schedule was never completed. Surveillance interval inadequacy is a contributing cause.

Fleet operating experience for bearing type BRNG-4518: observed wear rates 40% higher than design basis when operating at temperatures above 180F. Recommended PM interval reduction from 90 days to 60 days. Seven plants have not yet incorporated this OE into their PM programs. This represents a systemic latent vulnerability in the fleet corrective action program for OE incorporation.
